content:
As you step into the world of Tenebrous, the air thickens with the weight of oppression and rebellion. This realm is a furnace of human endeavor, where the pursuit of power and survival is a constant, never-ending battle. The shadows that shroud this land are alive with secrets and lies, whispering tales of ancient dynasties and forgotten catastrophes. Tenebrous is a world where the line between progress and ruin is blurred, where the faintest spark can set ablaze the very foundations of society.

The Great Scourge of 817 GD still casts its long shadow across this troubled land. The cataclysmic event that reshaped the world's politics and societies forever was triggered by the catastrophic failure of a massive magical experiment conducted by the Cygnus Order. Their hubris and recklessness led to their downfall as a dominant force on Tenebrous, but remnants of the original experiment still linger, waiting to be exploited or unleashed once more. The echoes of this cataclysmic event continue to shape the world's history, with various factions and powers jockeying for position in its wake.

The current state of affairs is one of growing unrest. Tensions are running high in New Erebo due to accusations against both the Kraelion Dynasty and rogue factions within the Ironworkers' Guild regarding a series of recent "mysterious" explosions that have left deep scars on the city's infrastructure. The underclass and lower-caste technocrats are seething with discontent, as whispers of a possible hidden heir to the throne spread among the high-born nobles and influential merchant houses. This perceived succession crisis has set off a scramble for power and position as various factions vie to secure their hold on Tenebrous's fragile future.

You find yourself standing in the midst of New Erebo's sprawling metropolis, amidst the sounds and smells of a city living on the edge. The distant hum of magical engines, the clang of hammering on metal, and the whispers of conspirators in dark alleys all blend together to create an atmosphere of foreboding tension. As you glance out upon this sea of steel and stone, your eyes fall upon a small, makeshift shrine dedicated to the forgotten victims of the recent explosions. Amidst the scattered candles and half-finished talismans lies a single, handwritten note – a name: "Raylan Orthal". The wind carries the faint whisper of a familiar voice in your mind, echoing the vow you made against the Kraelion Dynasty: "I will bring them down."
